entities.summary: Sergo Hambardzumyan was an Armenian heavyweight weightlifter. He won the Soviet national title in 1933–1935, finishing second in 1940 and third in 1937. Hambardzumyan set a world record in the total in 1938 and placed fifth at the 1946 World Weightlifting Championships.
